item.title: Password Audits Part 1: NTDS Extraction
item.author: spaniascharalampos@gmail.com.com (MollySec)
item.description:
What about Password “Audits”?

I recently jumped ship from the three-toed sloth-paced role of a security “specialist” (internal testing) to the cheetah-paced role of a cybersecurity consultant (external testing). I went from testing (close-to-zero-functionality) APIs (think dashboards) to <insert-something-that-can-be-tested-here-I-am-probably-testing-that>.

Among those things that can be tested, there is something with the posh title of “Password Audit”, which is basically the following:

Extract NTDS → Clean NTDS → Crack NTDS → Generate some stats.
